files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Report, per ward (lower case, no extra spaces), the average charge in two ways: once ignoring admissions without a charge, and once counting a missing charge as 0. Keep the original table unchanged and keep memory use low; a renamed version with the column called charge_eur may hold the zero-filled charges. `result` should be a table indexed by ward with the columns mean_known and mean_zero_filled, rounded to two decimals.
intended_computation: Per ward (5 wards): mean_known = mean of non-missing charges; mean_zero_filled = mean with the 12 missing charges counted as 0; both rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the renamed frame shares memory with the original, so zero-filling it also changes the original and the two means coincide

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
